outcome: Delivery within 24 h of membrane rupture
cohort: The study included women with preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) at <= 36 + 6 weeks' gestation who were planning vaginal delivery.
finding: Elevated maternal neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR > 10) is independently associated with spontaneous delivery within 24 hours in women with PPROM.
